name: Chicken Tacos with Spicy Mango, Bell Pepper & Cilantro Salsa

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 mangoes
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes
1 head butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a large bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallots and garlic; add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Juice limes into the bowl; add salt and stir to combine the mango salsa. Set aside.
Remove lettuce leaves from head, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates; fill with chicken, lettuce, and mango salsa. Enjoy!
